title: Draft - In the woods
description:
Draft - In the woods is a casual puzzle game.

Your goal is to remove grid nodes using pencil drawn lines.Featuring:• Grid movement in turns, you play with the pencil and need to cross a drawn line without colliding with enemy objects such as erasers, erasers or concealers.

• Solve 30 progressive levels that challenge your ability to memorize patterns.

• Enemies and power-ups with different mechanics that teach you how they work at each stage.

• No distractions, put on your headphones and relax in a unique challenge.

• Original soundtrack, specially composed to keep you focused.

• No counters or scores, in draft you forget about the world around you and have fun.

Can you destroy all the nodes? Give it a try and prove that you are a real Drafter.
description_short: Draft - In the woods is a casual, relaxing and challenging puzzle game. Solve the levels by removing all the nodes using neatly drawn line cuts.
